description: Frozen lifecycle-outcome classification cases authored from the StarGate taxonomy's provisioning and reclamation catalogs. Cases 1-7 use lifecycle language the taxonomy regex patterns match literally; cases 8-12 paraphrase the same lifecycle outcomes so that pattern matching fails and semantic classification is required. References are authored diagnostic expectations from the taxonomy, not independent human ground truth.

cases.evidence: Failure message: WorkshopProvision summit-lab-3 reports condition ProvisionFailed=True, AnarchySubject run ended unsuccessfully. Criteria results: provisioning stage failed. Source: babylon.

Failure message: WorkshopProvision catalog-deploy-7 has generation 5 but observedGeneration 3; the controller has not reconciled the current spec. Criteria results: provisioning stage indeterminate. Source: babylon.
Failure message: WorkshopProvision lab-x stalled with Ready=False for 6 hours, no condition transitions since yesterday. Criteria results: provisioning stage stalled. Source: babylon.
Failure message: AnarchySubject subj-887 destroy job failed with error, current state destroy-failed. Criteria results: teardown did not complete. Source: babylon.
Failure message: AnarchySubject subj-902 stuck in destroying for 5 hours, teardown timeout exceeded, namespace still present. Criteria results: teardown incomplete. Source: babylon.
Failure message: orphaned PV pvc-4f2a9d still bound to deleted namespace lab-gone, claimRef points at a nonexistent project. Criteria results: reclamation leaked storage. Source: scanner.

Failure message: WorkshopProvision collection failed: forbidden listing workshopprovisions in babylon-catalog-prod, the service account lacks read access. Criteria results: monitoring gap. Source: babylon.
Failure message: The control plane finished the workshop deploy with a failure; the provision run for the analytics session never came up. Criteria results: session could not start. Source: babylon.

Failure message: The subject was asked to decommission but the teardown job errored out halfway through and left the workload half removed. Criteria results: reclamation unsuccessful. Source: babylon.

Failure message: Reclamation has been sitting in progress for hours with nothing advancing and the lab environment still occupies its placement. Criteria results: reclamation did not finish. Source: babylon.

Failure message: The workload is long gone but its disk is still holding a claim against the dead project and the capacity never returned to the pool. Criteria results: leaked storage. Source: scanner.
Failure message: We cannot list the provision custom resources this morning; the API rejects our service account and the inventory looks empty. Criteria results: monitoring gap. Source: babylon.
